mn112:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn112:2.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
mn112:3.1: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ neva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ.
mn112:3.3: cattārome āvuso vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā
mn112:3.5: diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā sute sutavāditā mute mutavāditā viññāte viññātavāditā
mn112:3.6: ime kho āvuso cattāro vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:3.7: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imesu catūsu vohāresu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:4.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññāvimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
mn112:4.2: diṭṭhe kho ahaṃ āvuso anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharāmi
mn112:4.5: viññāte kho ahaṃ āvuso anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharāmi
mn112:4.6: evaṃ kho me āvuso jānato evaṃ passato imesu catūsu vohāresu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:5.1: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:5.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uttariṃ pañho pucchitabbo
mn112:5.3: pañca kho ime āvuso upādānakkhandhā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā
mn112:5.5: seyyathīdaṃ rūpūpādānakkhandho vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhandho saṅkhārūpādānakkhandho viññāṇūpādānakkhandho
mn112:5.6: ime kho āvuso pañcupādānakkhandhā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:5.7: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:6.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññāvimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
mn112:6.2: rūpaṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso abalaṃ virāgunaṃ anassāsikanti viditvā ye rūpe upādāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi
mn112:6.6: viññāṇaṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso abalaṃ virāgunaṃ anassāsikanti viditvā ye viññāṇe upādāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi
mn112:6.7: evaṃ kho me āvuso jānato evaṃ passato imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:7.1: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:7.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uttariṃ pañho pucchitabbo
mn112:7.3: chayimāvuso dhātuyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā
mn112:7.5: paṭhavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu ākāsadhātu viññāṇadhātu
mn112:7.6: imā kho āvuso cha dhātuyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:7.7: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imāsu chasu dhātūsu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:8.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññāvimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
mn112:8.2: paṭhavīdhātuṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso anattato upagacchiṃ na ca paṭhavīdhātunissitaṃ attānaṃ
mn112:8.3: ye ca paṭhavīdhātunissitā upādāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi
mn112:8.8: viññāṇadhātuṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso anattato upagacchiṃ na ca viññāṇadhātunissitaṃ attānaṃ
mn112:8.9: ye ca viññāṇadhātunissitā upādāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi
mn112:8.10: evaṃ kho me āvuso jānato evaṃ passato imāsu chasu dhātūsu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:9.1: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:9.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uttariṃ pañho pucchitabbo
mn112:9.3: cha kho panimāni āvuso ajjhattikāni bāhirāni āyatanāni tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātāni
mn112:9.5: cakkhu ceva rūpā ca sotaṃ ca saddā ca ghānaṃ ca gandhā ca jivhā ca rasā ca kāyo ca phoṭṭhabbā ca mano ca dhammā ca
mn112:9.6: imāni kho āvuso cha ajjhattikāni bāhirāni āyatanāni tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātāni.
mn112:9.7: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imesu chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:10.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññāvimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
mn112:10.2: cakkhusmiṃ āvuso rūpe cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upādāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi
mn112:10.7: manasmiṃ āvuso dhamme manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upādāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi
mn112:10.8: evaṃ kho me āvuso jānato evaṃ passato imesu chasu ajjhattika bāhiresu āyatanesu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:11.1: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:11.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uttariṃ pañho pucchitabbo
mn112:11.3: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅkāra mamaṅkāramānānusayā susaṃmūhatāti.
mn112:12.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññāvimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
mn112:12.2: pubbe kho ahaṃ āvuso āgāriyabhūto samāno aviddasu ahosiṃ
mn112:12.3: tassa me tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā dhammaṃ deseti
mn112:12.4: tāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhiṃ.
mn112:12.5: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhiṃ
mn112:12.7: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ
mn112:12.8: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
mn112:13.1: so kho ahaṃ āvuso aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
mn112:13.2: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī ahosiṃ.
mn112:13.3: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato ahosiṃ dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā vihāsiṃ.
mn112:13.4: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ahosiṃ ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
mn112:13.5: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato ahosiṃ saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
mn112:13.6: pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosiṃ ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ.
mn112:13.7: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosiṃ yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ.
mn112:13.8: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato ahosiṃ kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasañhitaṃ.
mn112:14.1: so bījagāma bhūtagāmasamārambhā paṭivirato ahosiṃ ekabhattiko ahosiṃ rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā
mn112:14.3: mālā gandha vilepana dhāraṇamaṇḍana vibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato ahosiṃ
mn112:14.18: chedana vadha bandhana viparāmosaālopa sahasākārā paṭivirato ahosiṃ.
mn112:14.19: so santuṭṭho ahosiṃ kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena yena yeneva pakkamiṃ samādāyeva pakkamiṃ.
mn112:14.20: seyyathāpi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti sapattabhārova ḍeti
mn112:14.21: evameva kho ahaṃ āvuso santuṭṭho ahosiṃ kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena yena yeneva pakkamiṃ samādāyeva pakkamiṃ.
mn112:14.22: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedesiṃ.
mn112:15.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī ahosiṃ nānubyañjanaggāhī
mn112:15.2: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjiṃ rakkhiṃ cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjiṃ
mn112:15.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī ahosiṃ nānubyañjanaggāhī
mn112:15.8: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjiṃ rakkhiṃ manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjiṃ.
mn112:15.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedesiṃ.
mn112:16.1: abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ahosiṃ ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī ahosiṃ asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ uccāra passāvakamme sampajānakārī ahosiṃ gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī ahosiṃ.
mn112:16.2: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato
mn112:16.3: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajiṃ araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn112:16.4: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdiṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn112:17.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā vihāsiṃ abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ
mn112:17.2: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto vihāsiṃ sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ
mn112:17.3: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho vihāsiṃ ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ
mn112:17.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato vihāsiṃ ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ
mn112:17.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho vihāsiṃ akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.
mn112:18.1: so pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn112:18.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ
mn112:18.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …
mn112:19.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn112:19.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ
mn112:19.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn112:20.1: tassa me evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha
mn112:20.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn112:20.4: evaṃ kho me āvuso jānato evaṃ passato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅkāra mamaṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatāti.
mn112:21.1: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:21.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā evamassa vacanīyo
mn112:21.3: lābhā no āvuso suladdhaṃ no āvuso
mn112:21.4: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ samanupassāmāti.
mn112:21.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
